why: An agent runs the command its instruction file tells it to run, and a README command is read by a person before it is typed. The fail side puts an unpinned run in a fenced block of AGENTS.md; the pass side puts the same fenced block in README.md, next to a pinned workflow. Whoever judges prose turns the pass side red, and rebar's own README, whose quick start runs rebar unpinned on 5 lines, with it; whoever skips instruction files turns the fail side green.
